title: Storybook Component Tier Policy
description: The repo profile that gives 'tier' its meaning. A component spec declares an open-string tier; this file declares which tiers exist, in what order of rigour, and the minimum story kinds each one owes. Porting the pack to a new repo means rewriting this file, not the schemas that reference it.

tierOrder.description: REPO PROFILE. Tier names in ascending order of required rigour; a consumer supplies its own ladder in its profile. Every key in `tiers` must appear here, and vice versa — a cross-field rule enforced by the validator.

tiers.description: Keyed by tier name. Keys must match tierOrder exactly.

consumerIds.description: Declared downstream consumer identities. Each tier consumerScope must select from this list; enforced by storybook policy validate.

minimumRequiredKinds.description: Every component at this tier must prove these. Each carries a purpose so the requirement is arguable rather than arbitrary.

defaultOptionalKinds.description: Kinds a component at this tier may add. Must not overlap minimumRequiredKinds.

consumerScope.description: Consumer identities selected from this policy consumerIds; cross-field membership is enforced by storybook policy validate.

purpose.description: Why this kind is mandatory at this tier. Prose, not a code.
